ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% high-intensity mottled white vs 40% low-intensity black across visible ventral regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous white mottled regions covering the interior of each lobe, bisected by a dark central triangular region. Dark pigmentation is concentrated along the trailing edge and lateral margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing edge with low-amplitude serrations; a distinct high-amplitude jagged indentation is visible on the distal section of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory from the submerged center toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-intensity pixel groups (barnacles) located on the distal ends of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible dark vertical and diagonal linear disruptions across the white pigmented areas on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on tips and a notable traumatic indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct dark circular spots (mottling) within the white interior of the left lobe.
